title: Sales Insight data lake SOW
methodology: The project runs in milestones, each ending with tests against the agreed definition of done. A design peer review with CUSTOMER_001 takes place before development starts, and each milestone is approved before the next begins.
architecture_note: A data lake on AWS that takes data from the ERP and the CRM, processes it, and serves the existing dashboards through SQL queries.
extraction_plan: Extract the ERP (SOURCE_001) tables in full mode to the raw layer in Amazon S3 using AWS Glue. This will run once a day.
Extract the CRM (SOURCE_002) data incrementally to the raw layer in Amazon S3 using AWS Glue. This will run every hour.
extraction_dod: Use case A - done when the daily sales report built from extracted data matches the current report.
Use case B - done when stock data is available in the raw layer within 2 hours of the change.
processing_dod: Use case A - done when the processed sales figures match the current Qlik results for the agreed test days.
Use case B - done when processed stock levels refresh within 2 hours.
consumer_dod: Use case A - done when the BI tool shows the daily sales report from the data lake through the connector.
Use case B - done when the stock dashboard shows data no older than 2 hours.
volume_assumptions: Current data volume is about 40 million rows.
Data volume is expected to double in two years.
assumptions: The Qlik scripts provided by CUSTOMER_001 describe the business logic completely.
The data can be stored in any AWS region until the customer answers the data location question.
deliverables: Landing zone and data infrastructure - done when the environment passes the agreed security checks.
Detailed design document - done when approved in the peer review.
Extraction, processing and consumer layers - done when use cases A and B pass their tests.
Training and knowledge transfer - done when the CUSTOMER_001 team has attended the sessions.
architecture_assumptions: One production data environment and one shared environment for security services.
The BI tool reaches the data lake through a connector, not directly.

data_env_costs.details: Storage for raw, parsed and curated data
Querying the data lake using SQL

open_questions.question: Must the data stay in one country or region?
What share of the total price should each milestone carry?

open_questions.assumed_meanwhile: Costs are shown as to be confirmed until the estimate is made.
